notes_for_editor: Fate disputed and unresolved: destroyed (firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts) vs the 40-foot tower removed (Forest Lookouts, which cites a Clearwater TPA annual report; the report itself was not read). Record's 1957 destroyed event kept; removal added. Record design was null and is filled from the 40-foot L-4 description. Elevation unknown (firelookout.com shows '?'). Idaho Fire Lookouts says it has no documented staffing history, so staffing is left out of the story. The 1915-1927 structures are described only briefly and may not all have been towers. The cptpa.com history supports the agency's later merger; the Potlatch and Clearwater names are as that site gives them. No source found on remains or access today; the one web search added nothing. Fact check 2026-10-10: the Forest Lookouts page gives its 1957 removal source as the Clearwater TPA annual report, so the citation is confirmed though the report was not read. The story cites only footnote 3 for the agency, since firelookout.com shows only the abbreviation CTPA.
